scope: Mobile GPU raster frame cost and manually timed bhop; all map geometry and saved preferences preserved

methodology.gpu: Real EGL3 pbuffer; Warehouse, seed 4242, one bot, paused simulation; 12 warmup frames, 30 complete frames with glFinish, median and p95. Per-pass timings use 15 samples and synchronization boundaries, so pass medians are not additive.
methodology.presented: Real MatchActivity GLSurfaceView, live simulation/HUD/vsync, saved Low preset, 75% scale, adaptive performance disabled, 60 FPS cap; 3.5 second warmup then 16 samples spaced 500ms apart. Spawn-camera sample, not a whole-map or sustained thermal benchmark.
methodology.assertions: No timing thresholds; correctness and GL errors are asserted. glFinish is test-only.
methodology.comparisonNote: GPU baseline uses 1920x1200 3D targets. Final Low at 75% uses approximately 960x600 on a 16:10 panel. This intentionally combines shader optimization with a lower pixel budget; it is not an equal-resolution visual-equivalence claim. Native-resolution HUD is unchanged.

changes: Evaluate material grain/patch noise only in branches that consume it; skip when footprint makes its weight zero
Compile a raster-only composite without RT upsampling/reflection code

Generate a 256x256 R8 hash texture once per GL context for the raster shader; retain procedural generation and distinct material patterns. Cached noise repeats every 256 cells and is quantized, not bit-identical to analytic noise
Low surface scale is relative to a 1,024,000-pixel base budget; other tiers and full-resolution HUD are unchanged
Reset draw-buffer mapping when a framebuffer shrinks from two color attachments to one
Bhop arms on a fresh airborne crouch after Jump release; landing opens a 180ms window; only a successful new jump grants speed, capped at 2.5x reference sprint speed
Missed timing/prolonged slide decays momentum rather than resetting speed in one frame; held Jump is not automatic bhop
Resolve vertical collisions to voxel faces so grounded does not flicker above the floor; preserve ceiling clearance
Hints and Android key-event tests use remappable actions rather than hardcoded Shift/Space
